page_title: BET 1-1 CAD | Betis v Cadiz CF 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Flag up against Isco (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+7' Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
90+6' A yellow card for a tackle by Isco (Betis). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+6' A yellow card is awarded to Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

90+4' Ayoze Perez (Betis) finds some space in the penalty area and produces a bullet of a header towards the top left corner, but his attempt is denied by the goalkeeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
90+3' Conan Ledesma pulls off a great save to deny Isco (Betis) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' The ball is out of play. Cadiz CF win a corner kick.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Ayoze Perez (Betis) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
88' Sergio prepares a substitution. Jorge Mere is replaced by Luis Hernandez (Cadiz).
88' The substitution has been made. Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) has replaced Gonzalo Escalante.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aitor Ruibal (Betis) will replace Hector Bellerin.
84' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
83' Ayoze Perez (Betis) is first to the cross from Luiz Henrique, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
83' A decent cross gives Chris Ramos (Cadiz) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.

82' German Pezzella (Betis) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
82' It will be a corner kick for Betis.
81' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
81' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
79' Luiz Henrique (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
78' Handball! A player from Cadiz CF handled the ball.
75' A cooling break is underway.
74' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' The attendance for today's match is 56087.
72' Here comes a substitution. Darwin Machis (Cadiz) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Alejo.
68' Sergio has decided to substitute Maximiliano Gomez and he is replaced by Roger Marti (Cadiz).
68' A substitution has been made. Robert Navarro is replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
66' Luiz Henrique (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
62' The ball goes out for a corner. Cadiz CF can continue in their attacking effort.
62' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Cadiz CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andres Guardado (Betis) comes onto the pitch for Marc Roca.
61' Here is a change. Juan Miranda is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Abner (Betis).
61' Here comes a substitution. Rodri is given a rest as he is replaced by Luiz Henrique (Betis).

60' 1 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Guido Rodriguez (Betis) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
59' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Isco (Betis) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
57' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' What a big chance! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
52' It should have been a goal! Robert Navarro (Cadiz) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
51' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
48' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
47' Foul! Isco (Betis) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) comes on the pitch for Willian Jose.
46' The whistle blows and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias starts the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Isco (Betis) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
45+5' Betis have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
45+5' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
45+2' Betis win a corner.
45+1' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) climbs highest inside the box and sends a poor header miles wide of the left post.
45' Juan Miranda (Betis) earns the yellow card.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' German Pezzella (Betis) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
45' The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
44' Betis couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
41' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 0:1.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Betis are awarded the free kick.
33' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
32' Cadiz CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cadiz CF.
29' The corner by Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
29' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
28' Ayoze Perez (Betis) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Conan Ledesma is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
27' Juan Miranda (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
27' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Rodri (Betis) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
26' A pass by Isco (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Willian Jose (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' A pass into the penalty area from Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is intercepted by the defence.
21' Juan Miranda (Betis) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
20' The foul by Guido Rodriguez (Betis) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
19' The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
17' One of the Betis players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
16' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
14' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul after Willian Jose (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
13' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
11' Isco (Betis) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
7' Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
5' Conan Ledesma (Cadiz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Juan Miranda (Betis) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ayoze Perez (Betis) and blew his whistle.
2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) heads on.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will referee today's match.
